full_name: Axel Meyer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: At the Radcliffe Institute, Axel Meyer is reviewing and synthesizing the knowledge on the evolution of the adaptive radiations of cichlid fishes that each are comprised of hundreds of unique species. These fish species flocks are textbook examples for extremely rapid diversification.
